when no learning candidate applies.


Task preferences (only within the rules above):
Teach how to use the input field in the user data with short natural examples, common collocations and relevant grammar constraints. Separate distinct senses and show common mistakes with corrections when useful. Prioritize patterns the learner can reuse; distinguish errors from acceptable regional or stylistic alternatives.

text: {"summary":"“used to”可表示过去常常做某事，也可表示习惯于某事，两者的句型不同。","content":"- **used to + 动词原形**：过去常常或曾经（现在通常不再如此）。例：I used to live here.（我以前住在这里。）\n- **be used to + 名词／动名词**：习惯于……。例：I’m used to getting up early.（我习惯早起。）","vocabulary":[{"form":"used to","type":"phrase","meaning":"过去常常；曾经","example":"I used to live here.","translation":"我以前住在这里。"},{"form":"be used to","type":"phrase","meaning":"习惯于……","example":"I’m used to getting up early.","translation":"我习惯早起。"}]}
